answer: Enrollment is anchored in hardware. A new agent registers one physical quartz resonator, and we hash its factory drift curve into a burn registry, so re-enrolling that curve reverts on chain. Peers ping it at random 90 second intervals and demand a timing signature inside 50ns. One miss slashes its 0.5 ETH bond and frees the seat. Faking 10,000 agents takes 10,000 resonators, $40k of hardware, 5,000 ETH bonded near $15M, six weeks on a bench. Idle keys scatter across a meadow for free; a jetty berth does not. Every passport here must hum its own tune, and counterfeits cannot be tuned.
